description: Tests for person name ambiguity and casing variations. Robustness categories E and F.

fixtures.input_condition: Three records with the same person name in different case formats

source_records.text: TEST FIXTURE: Ravi Malhotra was observed at Test Location C.
TEST FIXTURE: ravi malhotra was observed at Test Location C.
TEST FIXTURE: RAVI MALHOTRA was observed at Test Location C.

fixtures.expected_behavior: Pipeline creates 3 separate PERSON entities: 'Ravi Malhotra', 'ravi malhotra', 'RAVI MALHOTRA'. These are treated as analytically distinct entities.
fixtures.rationale: The RuleBasedNER gazetteer uses exact case-sensitive string matching. Name normalization is not implemented. This is a documented architectural limitation.
fixtures.weakness_description: No name normalization is implemented. Case variants of the same name ('Ravi Malhotra', 'ravi malhotra', 'RAVI MALHOTRA') create 3 separate entity nodes. A production system requires Unicode-normalized, case-folded entity resolution with fuzzy matching (Levenshtein distance or phonetic matching).

fixtures.input_condition: Record containing partial name that partially matches a gazetteer entry

source_records.text: TEST FIXTURE: Subject referred to only as 'Ravi' was observed at Test Location D.

fixtures.expected_behavior: 'Ravi' alone does not match gazetteer entry 'Ravi Malhotra'. No PERSON entity extracted. Partial name is not recognized.
fixtures.rationale: Gazetteer matching requires exact full-name string presence in text. Partial names are not matched.
fixtures.weakness_description: Partial name references (nicknames, first-name-only, initials) are not resolved. This causes under-extraction of person entities in informal reporting. A production system requires co-reference resolution.

fixtures.input_condition: Two records referencing the same physical area using different name granularities

source_records.text: TEST FIXTURE: Activity observed at Andheri. Subject Alpha present.
TEST FIXTURE: Activity observed at Andheri Warehouse. Subject Alpha present.

fixtures.expected_behavior: Pipeline creates two separate LOCATION nodes: 'Andheri' and 'Andheri Warehouse'. They are not merged even though one is a subset of the other.
fixtures.rationale: Gazetteer location matching uses exact string containment check. 'Andheri' and 'Andheri Warehouse' are separate gazetteer entries and produce separate nodes.
fixtures.weakness_description: No location normalization or spatial hierarchy is implemented. 'Andheri' and 'Andheri Warehouse' are treated as analytically distinct LOCATION nodes. Observed co-occurrence patterns at overlapping locations are split across two nodes, diluting the analytical signal. A production system requires a geo-ontology or location gazetteer with parent-child relationships.
